title: Set Up Business Central Data Mirroring to Microsoft Fabric
summary: Set up data mirroring from Business Central online to Microsoft Fabric to synchronize Business Central data to an open mirrored database in OneLake for use with Fabric analytics tools. Configure the connection using assisted setup or the Microsoft Fabric Mirroring Setup page, select companies and tables to synchronize, and manage authentication through a service principal.
features: Connect to Microsoft Fabric assisted setup
